title: Disorders of bone marrow failure
summary: Bone marrow failure (aplastic anemia, myelodysplastic syndrome, etc.) with severe infection or bleeding requiring hospitalizations, OR transfusion-dependence, OR severe cytopenias.

children.criterion: Hospitalization for complications (severe infection or hemorrhage) requiring ≥48-hour hospitalization, occurring at least three times within 12-month period
Transfusion-dependent severe anemia (Hgb ≤7.0) on at least 3 occasions in 12 months, OR thrombocytopenia (PLT ≤30,000) on at least 3 evaluations 30+ days apart in 12 months
